content.short: Pixel Chain Games focuses on developing decentralized game contracts.
content.description: Pixel Chain Games developed an SVG NFT contract that stores artwork on-chain by encoding it within the ERC-721 token metadata, thereby removing the need for IPFS-stored NFTs for play cards. The project runs its gameplay through a coordinated set of smart contracts, with the game rules and mechanics enforced on-chain. This design keeps operations fully decentralized, eliminating reliance on centralized servers or intermediaries and enabling transparent ownership and interaction with the assets.
